# ui-table

> Data table with sortable columns, row selection, column resizing, and row reordering.

**Class:** `UITable`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `selectable` | `boolean` | Enables row selection on click |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | Enables column resize handles |
| `reorderable` | `boolean` | Enables drag-to-reorder rows |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `store` | `TableStore` | no |  |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-table-sort` | Fired when sort changes with `{ column, direction }` detail |
| `ui-table-select` | Fired when row selection changes with `{ value, selected, allSelected }` detail |

## CSS Tokens

Public `--ui-*` custom properties consumed by this component:

- `--ui-focus-ring`
- `--ui-font-weight-button`
- `--ui-font-weight-text`
- `--ui-group-header-font`
- `--ui-line-height-text`

## ui-table-row

> Table row that supports selection when the parent table is selectable.

**Class:** `UITableRow`

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Row identifier used for selection tracking |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Whether this row is selected |

## ui-table-header

> Column header cell with optional sort toggle.

**Class:** `UITableHeader`

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `sort` | `string` | Current sort state: "none" | "asc" | "desc" |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | Enables click-to-sort behavior |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `column` | `string` | yes |  |

### Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-sort` | Fired on sort toggle with `{ column }` detail |
